storyCards.headline: More Love: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Kim Carnes's "More Love" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "More Love" is a 1967 hit single recorded by the American soul group The Miracles for Motown Records' Tamla label.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

More Love was released in 1980.
